title: Kneaded Tomato Bread
description: A simple bread recipe that combines the tanginess of tomatoes with the richness of kneaded dough.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
2. Gradually add in olive oil and knead the dough for 10 minutes.
3. Let the dough rest for 1 hour in a warm place.
5. Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/2 inch.
6. Spread diced tomatoes on top of the dough.
7. Roll the dough into a log shape and place it on a baking sheet.
8. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
9. Let cool for 10 minutes before slicing.
